Should You Get the Video Package?

Our honest take: Phone photos from 2,000m altitude are underwhelming — wind, shaking hands, and a tiny screen. The GoPro is mounted on a reinforced selfie stick by your pilot, capturing angles your phone simply can't. 90% of our passengers wish they'd booked it if they didn't.

That said, if you're on a strict budget, the $150 standard flight is still incredible. The views are free — you just won't have professional footage to relive them.

Want the ultimate media experience? Our VIP package includes extended flight time for even more footage.
